title: Writing Specs an AI Can Be Held To
description: Turning a feature request into an executable specification — inputs, outputs, invariants, error cases, and explicit non-goals — so ambiguity produces a question instead of confidently wrong code.

title: Test-First With AI
description: Having the model write tests from the spec before any implementation exists, and the specific tests AI systematically forgets to write.

title: Verifying Without Reading Every Line
description: Checking behaviour at the edges instead of auditing every generated line, and recognizing tests that pass without proving anything — closing with the spec and test plan artefact.
